units.gaps: Every kind:'object' marker draws a 0.8in yellow #e0b54a cube, so yes, that cube is the Red Rocket. Searchables draw a tan crate, so faces are ignored. Needs a per-face model.

box-1..4 sides list no forces, so DEFAULT_FORCES[i] fills them by seat index. Box-1: BoS gets Super Mutants. Box-2: the super-mutants defender gets Survivors. Box-3/4: the attacker, which the sheet names as Survivors, gets Super Mutants. No caps cap anywhere, and the sheets set none.

Sides are BoS (Attacker, south edge) vs Scavengers (north edge). Needs a BoS force with no power armor, since the suits are the prize. Scavenger faction is unsourced (Survivors or Raiders Scavvers: needs a RULING). Suits are searchables that must be targetable with PA-card armor and health. Picking one gives a random T-45/T-51/T-60. +50 caps per suit is not implemented. Look: an empty upright PA suit on a 40mm base, about 2.2in tall.

Defender = Super Mutants inside Red of the nuke. Attacker faction is open. The nuke check applies to SHOTS only: a red armor die roll of 1 detonates it, anything else hits the carrier. Containers are Yellow x Orange, Orange apart. The game ends at round 9. Look: a mini-nuke shell about 1.2in long.

Attacker = Survivors, +20% caps. Defender is any faction; the text mentions feral ghouls. Survivors deploy within Yellow of all edges. The attacker places the first book. Look: a book stack on a 25mm marker. The school is a walled maze.

Defender = BoS with an optional turret, which is missing. Attacker = Survivors, +20% caps. The map shows the attacker zone on the north edge only. Reserve reinforcements are not built. Look: a lattice radio mast about 4in tall on a 4in square footprint.

Kidnappers get no forces at double Flip's caps. The rescue and the Sarah spawn are not built (Laser Rifle Survivor). Flip zone is Red of the north edge. Look: a captive kneeling, tied, on a 32mm base.
